blind_audit: 8 fixed-seed image-clean pairs per domain; baseline_dedup, corrected_labels_dedup, corrected_lora_only_dedup in randomized unnamed order; no references shown. Record clear unsupported claims, omissions, ties and uncertainty. Assistant reviewer, not independent human adjudication.
full_sft_gate: At most one full-test candidate evaluation if one corrected-label SFT arm improves point-estimate CIDEr in both domains, drops neither BLEU-4 by more than 1 point, and blinded visual review has more wins than losses against baseline. Otherwise finish this run without additional SFT tuning.
final_run: curated_sft_v4: explicit pre-model seed, no length grouping, verify actual initialization hashes and sample order before scoring
image_first_audit: Observe selected images before model captions/references; never use audit observations for training. Confirm later caption-audit IDs match this frozen selection.
primary_baseline: Published checkpoint rerun on A100-40GB BF16/greedy, matching SFT requested hardware and generation settings. Cached A10 captions retained separately.
full_sft_candidate_selection: Among corrected-label arms meeting the predeclared metric and blind-review gate, choose the one with the larger equal-domain mean raw CIDEr gain versus the matched A100 baseline; run at most one full-test SFT candidate. No post-result training adjustments.
post_outcome_source_edits: Integrity checks, metadata exports and idempotent metric-file handling only; no new training recipe, candidate threshold or dedup-rule changes after GPU-stage outcomes.
baseline_hardware_note: All arms requested A100-40GB. Matched baseline was actually assigned NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB by Modal. A100-family match, not independently verified identical physical SKU for all SFT jobs.
